messages:
Taylor: hi @people-ops — i'd like to request a formal accommodation. i have chronic autoimmune fatigue and recent flares make 5 days in-office unreliable. proposing hybrid 3 remote / 2 in-office (non-consecutive), flexible start times, and a temporary oncall reassignment for ~3 months. worried about how this intersects with my upcoming performance conversation. cc @Jordan
Maria HR: thanks for flagging this, @Taylor. please DM me when you can. we can start an ADA-style accommodation case. medical documentation helps but we can be flexible while we set up a plan. we typically propose a phased integration and a short-term check-in cadence tied to performance expectations. @Jordan — can you confirm operational constraints?
Jordan (Eng Manager): thanks for telling us, Taylor. my main concern is sprint reviews and pairing sessions. we can shift heavier syncs to afternoons and lean on async notes. also okay to reassign oncall for a temporary period if needed. Jordan to Taylor: please send preferred in-office days, i can try to align team schedules.
Taylor: thanks @Jordan — afternoons would help a lot. i can do Tue/Thu in-office for now. i'm also fine with a short-term objectives doc so expectations are explicit. :pray:
Maria HR: i'll open a confidential accommodation case and propose the following: (1) 2-week phased start (reduce in-office in week 1), (2) 90-day check-in aligned to the performance cycle, (3) temporary oncall reassignment for ~3 months, (4) flexible start window +/- 60 mins. we will keep details private to necessary parties. policy link: <https://intranet/redwood/accom-policy|Accommodation policy>. PeopleOps Bot: case #AC-1342 opened.
PeopleOps Bot: Case AC-1342 created by Maria HR. Next step: schedule intake call with Taylor and Maria HR. Owner: Maria HR.
Sam E.: Jordan — i'm happy to take more live pairing when Taylor is remote and help create async pairing notes. we can also set a short checklist for context handoffs.
Jordan (Eng Manager): great, thanks Sam. Maria — please add a temporary objectives doc to the case and confirm the 90-day check-in expectations. Taylor — we'll track a few success metrics: PR review turnaround, sprint story completion rate, and participation in async design notes. we'll avoid surprise meetings on your in-office days. :thumbsup:
Taylor: appreciate this so much. i'll DM Maria the note from my clinician later today and will review the proposed objectives when you post them. thank you all for being flexible.
